target_customer: Startups and established firms that need electronic product development help
problem: Companies building electronic products needed faster engineering of electronics and development tools without hiring a full hardware team.
business_model: Client services (engineering projects) plus licensing of embedded software technology from parent Outbreak, Inc.
product_category: Hardware engineering services and development tools

founders.name: Kuy Mainwaring
previous_startups: Outbreak, Inc. (embedded software R&D group founded 2008, parent of Logiblock)
founders.background_notes: Named as the only founder on the YC page. The YC page does not say Mainwaring founded Outbreak, so that link is stated as the company's own description only.

exit.reason: Not public. YC lists the company as inactive; no news found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Embedded software and electronics design for client products is standard but specialized engineering work.

defensibility.rationale: A client services division sells engineering hours, which scale with headcount and are easy for other design firms to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows any incumbent acting on the wedge or buying the company.

market_need_then: The YC description states that electronic product development was slow for startups and established firms, but no 2013 data on demand, spend or customers was found.

branding.domain_note: logiblock.com per the YC page; the fetch returned a 503 error so no domain history was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material was found. Search returns the unrelated Logiblocs kit, LogicBlocks and an indie game, showing the name is easy to confuse.

outcome_analysis: Logiblock was the client services division of Outbreak, Inc., selling electronics engineering and development tools in the Winter 2013 batch with a listed team size of zero. It is now inactive, but searches for shutdown, funding, competitors and branding found nothing, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty.
notes: Five searches (outcome, funding, competitors, branding, name alone) returned only unrelated results. logiblock.com returned HTTP 503 on fetch, so the site is not confirmed dead. Founding year is not stated: Outbreak was founded in 2008 per YC, Logiblock itself is undated. No competitor with a source dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty.
